result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make **empathy paired with critical thinking** a universal foundation of how people are raised and educated.

So many of the world’s biggest problems—conflict, inequality, polarization, environmental neglect—persist not because we lack resources, but because we struggle to understand each other and to reason clearly about complex trade-offs. If more people could genuinely consider perspectives different from their own while also thinking rigorously about evidence and consequences, cooperation would become easier, cruelty would be harder, and better solutions would follow.

It wouldn’t make the world perfect, but it would make it far more just, resilient, and kind.
